## 2. Rewritten page

# HVAC Scheduling and Dispatch Software for Contractors

Fieldnote is field-service management software built for HVAC contractors. It combines a drag-and-drop dispatch board, recurring maintenance agreements, and automatic technician assignment by skill and distance. It is used by 1,200 HVAC companies, and the median customer has 6 technicians.

Pricing is $39 per user per month billed annually, or $49 month-to-month. There is a 14-day free trial with no card required. [Start your free trial]

## What Fieldnote's HVAC scheduling software does

- **Drag-and-drop dispatch board:** move jobs between technicians and days in one view.
- **Recurring maintenance agreements:** set up service plans once, and visits appear on the schedule automatically.
- **Automatic technician assignment:** Fieldnote suggests a technician based on skill and distance.

## HVAC dispatch by skill and distance

When a job comes in, Fieldnote matches it to technicians who have the required skill, then favors the one closest to the job site. Dispatchers can accept the assignment or drag the job to someone else.

## Does Fieldnote work offline?

The Fieldnote technician mobile app works offline and syncs when the device is back online. The office web app used by dispatchers needs an internet connection.

## QuickBooks integration

Fieldnote syncs two ways with **QuickBooks Online**: customers, invoices and payments. **QuickBooks Desktop is not supported.**

## Fieldnote pricing

| Plan | Price | Billing |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | $39 per user per month | Billed annually |
| Month-to-month | $49 per user per month | Billed monthly |

There is no free plan. Every account can start with a 14-day free trial, no card required. Prices current as of November 2025.

## Results from Fieldnote customers

In a March 2025 survey of 210 Fieldnote customers, dispatchers reported cutting scheduling time from 9 to 4 hours a week. This is self-reported survey data, not a controlled study.

## FAQ

**How much does Fieldnote cost?**
Fieldnote costs $39 per user per month when billed annually, or $49 per user per month billed month-to-month. There is a 14-day free trial that does not require a credit card. Pricing is current as of November 2025.

**Is there a free version of Fieldnote?**
No. Fieldnote does not have a free plan. It offers a 14-day free trial with no card required, after which the price is $39 per user per month (annual) or $49 (monthly).

**Does Fieldnote work offline?**
Partly. The Fieldnote technician mobile app works offline and syncs when the device reconnects. The Fieldnote office web app, used for dispatch and scheduling, requires an internet connection.

**Does Fieldnote integrate with QuickBooks?**
Fieldnote integrates with QuickBooks Online, with two-way sync of customers, invoices and payments. Fieldnote does not support QuickBooks Desktop.

**How does Fieldnote assign HVAC technicians to jobs?**
Fieldnote's automatic technician assignment matches each job to technicians with the right skills and favors those closest to the job site. Dispatchers can accept the suggestion or reassign the job on the drag-and-drop dispatch board.

**How much time does Fieldnote save on scheduling?**
In a March 2025 survey of 210 Fieldnote customers, dispatchers reported cutting scheduling time from 9 to 4 hours a week. The figures are self-reported by customers.

## 4. Blog post and internal linking plan

- **Separate the intents.** Retitle `/blog/hvac-scheduling-guide` around the informational query (e.g. "How to Schedule HVAC Technicians: A Practical Guide"). Remove "hvac scheduling software" from its title, H1 and meta description. The product page owns that query.
- **Link blog to product.** Add a link high in the blog post with the anchor "HVAC scheduling software" pointing to the product page, plus a trial CTA at the end. Link back from the product page to the guide only in a "learn more" context, with the anchor "HVAC scheduling guide".
- **Keep canonicals self-referencing.** Do not canonicalize the blog to the product page. If both URLs still alternate for the query after 6–8 weeks, consolidate by merging the useful blog content and 301-redirecting.
- **Point site-wide links at the product page.** Home, pricing, integrations and other blog posts should link to it with "HVAC scheduling software" or "HVAC dispatch software" anchors, not generic "learn more".
- **Measure.** Track which URL GSC reports for "hvac scheduling software" weekly. Also re-check the AI answer for "does fieldnote work offline" after recrawl.

---

## 5. Rationale

**Targeted:** "hvac scheduling software" and "hvac dispatch software" (most impressions, weak CTR, so the new title and H1 plus a stronger snippet). "Does fieldnote work offline" and "hvac software quickbooks integration" now get direct, accurate answers, which also corrects the AI answer's false "requires internet" claim. The at-a-glance table mirrors the price, QuickBooks and offline columns the AI overview compares. "Fieldnote pricing" already converts at 50%, so I kept clear pricing content and didn't disturb it.

**Deliberately not targeted:** "hvac scheduling app free" has no honest answer, since there is no free plan. It gets one FAQ, not a page-level push. "Best hvac software for small business" is a listicle query, and we can't truthfully claim "best". A separate comparison page suits it better.

**Removed:** "#1", the $29 price and "Get started free" were unsupported or wrong. Check ads and other pages for the same errors.
